resources.string: TAP MICROPHONE TO SPEAK OR TYPE COMMAND BELOW
JARVIS AI • Created & developed by Ankit Gothwal
JARVIS uses your microphone only when you tap the Speak button so your voice commands can be processed locally on your phone. No audio is recorded in the background or sent to external servers.
Microphone permission is currently turned off. You can enable it in Android App Settings to use voice commands, or continue typing commands manually.
